name: Adminer
description: A single-file database client in the browser. It reaches databases over the Docker network, so it needs no database port published to the host.

access.note: Adminer has no account of its own: the login form asks for a database server, username and password, so you sign in with credentials your database already has. Anyone who reaches this address gets that form and can try credentials against every database container on the Docker network, so either give the domain proxy password protection or leave the domain empty and reach it over the leased loopback port.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Adminer can reach every database on this host. Put it behind the proxy and restrict it, or leave the domain empty and reach it over the loopback port.

update.notes: Adminer is a single PHP file; upgrades keep no state. Adminer 6 drops the MongoDB, Elasticsearch and SQLite 2 drivers that 4.x offered.
